module "Rf_ArgumentMatching.dss"

product 0 Material "M_ArgumentMatching" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L10:C20 "Named"
  %1 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=1) : float2 @L11:C25 "Positional"
  %2 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0, 0), ParameterName="Colour", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L5:C1 "Colour"
  %3 = Swizzle(%2, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L5:C1 "BaseColor"
  %4 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](A=%3, ConstAlpha=0.5, ConstB=0) : float3 @L12:C19 "BaseColor"
  %5 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.25), ParameterName="Alpha", SortPriority=1) : float @L6:C1 "Alpha"
  %6 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](A=%3, Alpha=%5, ConstB=0) : float3 @L13:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %7 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="x") : float @L14:C17 "Opacity"
  %8 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="y") : float @L14:C27 "Opacity"
  %9 = Add(%7, %8) : float @L14:C17 "Opacity"
  %10 = MaterialSink(BaseColor=%4, EmissiveColor=%6, Opacity=%9) @L8:C1
  sink %10
